review.images: Visually checked the wide hero and eight gallery scenes on the official Hillside B page. The hero represents the wider Hillside development as published for Hillside B.
review.location: Verified the official named Hillside B point, the Dubai Hills Estate regional map from the same page and four named destinations. Project-specific driving estimates were not verified. Future lines are qualified.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all four image-only original Emaar sheets distributed through the White & Co public document listing. Each sheet explicitly identifies Hillside B. Checked five area tables and their components to the centesimal square foot. Other portal diagrams with different areas were not substituted.

unavailable: A broader Hillside B plan pack, current drive times, unit-specific entrance coordinates and signed plans were not verified.
